implementation_summary: Added a fixed source-independent Consumer Governance trigger corpus and strict deterministic integrity grader. The corpus separates positive, negative, and near-miss activation cases across train and validation partitions and covers coexistence, Consumer-vs-Maintainer separation, managed surfaces, no-SDD behavior, and source independence without model-backed judgment.

results.corpus_check: PASS: 36 cases; 6 per category per partition

verification.runtime_harness: Deterministic grader and mutation tests validate corpus structure and coverage. No live model/provider trial is part of T015.

limitations: Probabilistic or model-backed trigger trials are deferred to a separately authorized release-eval task.
This corpus and grader prove deterministic integrity and coverage, not runtime model activation accuracy.
rollback: Revert implementation commit cbf682321eadf9e6e7a7d9ae86114726583c0187 to remove only the T015 corpus, grader, and tests; revert the handoff-only successor separately if needed.
